system.description: Void Incarnate: You have a connection with a third Entity of your choice from the Entities of Void Sheet. When you summon it, you gain the Manifest benefit of that Entity.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v3.0 Fist

system.gmNotes: Authored as printed: "Manifest benefit" is almost certainly a copy error for the Vessel benefit, as in Blackened Marrow.
